config.nei_recheck: NLI over every retrieved sentence; flag a NOT_ENOUGH_INFO verdict if entail or contradict probability > tau and retry once with feedback naming the sentence
config.thinking_tokens: logged and reported per arm; not a stop condition

selection_rules.judge_prompt: judge-v1 frozen by decision: judge-v2's macro-F1 edge was one claim and v2 was written after seeing v1's errors on the same 60 train claims; v2 is a train-only ablation
selection_rules.nei_recheck: maximise (fixes - harms) over tau in 0.5/0.7/0.9/0.95/0.98 subject to fixes > harms; if none qualifies the rule is dropped and B1/B2 are the polarity-only variants

secondary_isolating_components: B1p - B0 and B2p - B0 (polarity checks alone)
B1 - B1p and B2 - B2p (the recheck added to each polarity check)
pre_declared_analysis.method: paired bootstrap over claims, 5000 resamples, 95% percentile intervals; the abstain policy is reported alongside. Secondary comparisons are exploratory and uncorrected.
pre_declared_analysis.no_changes_after_freeze: no prompt, rule, threshold or policy changes once the dev run starts; the dev run executes once

dev_run_command: python scripts/run_verification.py --stage run --split dev --label frozen --judge-version judge-v1 --relation-version relation-v1 --thinking low --k 5 --max-attempts 2 --arms B0,B3,N,B1p,B2p,B1,B2,A,oracle --workers 6 --rpm 60 --validation-gold 188 --validation-shuffled 60 --phase dev --phase-cap-inr 250
